description: Mark a problem a false alarm, as the Problems page does: it stops counting in totals, categories and release gates, but stays visible on its conversation. dismissed false puts it back. With add_to_never_flag, a do-not-flag rule is also written from its category (or from the problem itself), so the judge stops reporting that behaviour; do that only when the user says the behaviour is correct for their agent.

add_to_never_flag.description: Also write a do-not-flag rule from the problem's category (or the problem when it has none), so the judge stops reporting it.
add_to_never_flag.title: Add To Never Flag

dismissed.description: False puts a dismissed problem back.
dismissed.title: Dismissed

problem.description: The problem's id, as list_problems shows it.
problem.title: Problem

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

name: dismiss_problem
